entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sarah Jenkins. s.jenkins@email.com. Just tell me yes or no on the return.

Okay, one moment, Sarah... I'm pulling up your account now. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I'm understanding correctly, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just... hard to use. The interface is confusing and not at all what I thought it would be. I even read the user manual, and I just expected more for the price. I don't want it.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a good fit for you. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order.
Right. So can I return it?
Yes, it looks like you can. I see it was delivered 29 days ago, and our policy allows for returns on items within 10 days of delivery. You're unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Okay, finally. Good. So what's next?

I've just initiated the return process. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
